revision.comment: 新しいページ：潮崎山古墳（広島県福山市にある古墳）。
revision.text:
{{日本の古墳 |名称 = 潮崎山古墳 |画像 = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
墳丘（手前に想定前方部、左奥に想定後円部） |別名 = |所属 = |所在地 = [[広島県]][[福山市]][[芦田町]]大字下有地 |緯度度 = 34|緯度分 = 32|緯度秒 = 26.56 |経度度 =133|経度分 = 17|経度秒 = 4.77 |ISO = JP-34 |形状 = （推定）[[前方後円墳]] |規模 = |埋葬施設 = （伝）石槨 |出土品 = （伝）[[三角縁神獣鏡]]・鉄斧 |陪塚 = |築造時期 = [[4世紀]]代 |被葬者 = |陵墓 = |史跡 = なし |有形文化財 = 伝出土鏡・鉄斧（広島県指定文化財） |特記事項 = |地図 = Japan Hiroshima |アイコン = |ラベル = 潮崎山古墳 |ラベル位置 = top }} '''潮崎山古墳'''（しおざきやまこふん）は、[[広島県]][[福山市]][[芦田町]]下有地（しもあるじ）にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[前方後円墳]]と推定される。史跡指定はされていない。伝出土鏡・鉄斧が広島県指定重要文化財に指定されている。 == 概要 == [[ファイル:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|伝出土[[三角縁神獣鏡]]（複製）}}{{small|[[広島県立みよし風土記の丘|みよし風土記の丘ミュージアム（広島県立歴史民俗資料館）]]展示。}}]] 広島県東部、[[芦田川]]南岸において芦田川・神谷川の合流点を見下ろす丘陵上に築造された古墳である。[[江戸時代]]後期の[[文政]]10年（[[1827年]]）に発掘されているが（『西備名区』）{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}、これまでに発掘調査は実施されていない。 墳丘は大きく削平を受けているため墳形は明らかでないが、前方後円形と推定され、墳丘長30メートル・後円部直径17メートル程度と見積もられる{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}。主体部の埋葬施設は、『西備名区』の記述によれば石槨とされる{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}。副葬品としては、江戸時代の発掘の際に[[三角縁神獣鏡]]・鉄斧が出土したと伝わる。築造時期は[[古墳時代]]前期の[[4世紀]]代と推定され、備後地方における代表的な初期古墳（備後地方最古の前方後円墳か）として重要視される古墳になる{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}。 伝出土鏡・鉄斧は[[1981年|1981]]・[[1982年]]（[[昭和]]56・57年）に広島県指定重要文化財に指定された。現在では想定後円部の墳頂に千葉修理之進の墓が建立されている。 == 文化財 == === 広島県指定文化財 === * 重要文化財（有形文化財） ** 伝潮崎山古墳出土三角縁五神四獣鏡及び短冊型鉄斧（考古資料） - 1981年（昭和56年）11月6日指定、1982年（昭和57年）2月23日に追加指定・名称変更[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html 伝潮崎山古墳出土三角縁五神四獣鏡及び短冊型鉄斧]（広島県教育委員会「ホットライン教育ひろしま」）。。 *** 三角縁五神四獣鏡 - 直径22.0センチメートル、厚さ0.2-0.3センチメートル。[[国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|国分寺古墳]]（[[鳥取県]][[倉吉市]]）出土鏡と同笵史跡説明板。。 *** 短冊型鉄斧 - 長さ24.8センチメートル、幅頭部5.5センチメートル、幅中央部6.0センチメートル、幅刃部7.0-7.5センチメートル、厚さ1-4センチメートル。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 関連施設 == * [[広島県立みよし風土記の丘|みよし風土記の丘ミュージアム（広島県立歴史民俗資料館）]]（三次市小田幸町） - 潮崎山古墳の伝出土鏡複製品等を展示。 * [[広島県立歴史博物館|ふくやま草戸千軒ミュージアム（広島県立歴史博物館）]]（福山市西町） - 潮崎山古墳の伝出土鏡複製品等を展示。 * 福山市しんいち歴史民俗博物館（福山市新市町） - 潮崎山古墳の伝出土鏡複製品等を展示。 == 参考文献 == * 史跡説明板（福山市教育委員会設置） * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=小都隆|year=1989|chapter=潮崎山古墳|title=[[日本古墳大辞典]]|publisher=[[東京堂出版]]|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}}} == 外部リンク == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html 伝潮崎山古墳出土三角縁五神四獣鏡及び短冊型鉄斧] - 広島県教育委員会「ホットライン教育ひろしま」 * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html 伝潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁五神四獣鏡] - 福山市ホームページ {{デフォルトソート:しおさきやまこふん}} [[category:広島県の古墳]] [[category:福山市の歴史]] [[category:前方後円墳]]

墳丘（手前に想定前方部、左奥に想定後円部） |別名 = |所属 = |所在地 = [[広島県]][[福山市]][[新市町]]大字相方 |緯度度 = 34|緯度分 = 32|緯度秒 = 26.56 |経度度 =133|経度分 = 17|経度秒 = 4.77 |ISO = JP-34 |形状 = （推定）[[前方後円墳]] |規模 = |埋葬施設 = （伝）石槨 |出土品 = （伝）[[三角縁神獣鏡]]・鉄斧 |陪塚 = |築造時期 = [[4世紀]]代 |被葬者 = |陵墓 = |史跡 = なし |有形文化財 = 伝出土鏡・鉄斧（広島県指定文化財） |特記事項 = |地図 = Japan Hiroshima |アイコン = |ラベル = 潮崎山古墳 |ラベル位置 = top }} '''潮崎山古墳'''（しおざきやまこふん）は、[[広島県]][[福山市]][[新市町]]相方（さがた）にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[前方後円墳]]と推定される。史跡指定はされていない。伝出土鏡・鉄斧が広島県指定重要文化財に指定されている。 == 概要 == [[ファイル:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|伝出土[[三角縁神獣鏡]]（複製）}}{{small|[[広島県立みよし風土記の丘|みよし風土記の丘ミュージアム（広島県立歴史民俗資料館）]]展示。}}]] 広島県東部、[[芦田川]]南岸において芦田川・神谷川の合流点を見下ろす丘陵上に築造された古墳である。[[江戸時代]]後期の[[文政]]10年（[[1827年]]）に発掘されているが（『[[西備名区]]』）{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}、これまでに発掘調査は実施されていない。 墳丘は大きく削平を受けているため墳形は明らかでないが、前方後円形と推定され、墳丘長30メートル・後円部直径17メートル程度と見積もられる{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}。主体部の埋葬施設は、『西備名区』の記述によれば石槨とされる{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}。副葬品としては、江戸時代の発掘の際に[[三角縁神獣鏡]]・鉄斧が出土したと伝わる。築造時期は[[古墳時代]]前期の[[4世紀]]代と推定され、備後地方における代表的な初期古墳（備後地方最古の前方後円墳か）として重要視される古墳になる{{Sfn|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}。 伝出土鏡・鉄斧は[[1981年|1981]]・[[1982年]]（[[昭和]]56・57年）に広島県指定重要文化財に指定された。現在では想定後円部の墳頂に千葉修理之進の墓が建立されている。 == 文化財 == === 広島県指定文化財 === * 重要文化財（有形文化財） ** 伝潮崎山古墳出土三角縁五神四獣鏡及び短冊型鉄斧（考古資料） - 1981年（昭和56年）11月6日指定、1982年（昭和57年）2月23日に追加指定・名称変更[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html 伝潮崎山古墳出土三角縁五神四獣鏡及び短冊型鉄斧]（広島県教育委員会「ホットライン教育ひろしま」）。。 *** 三角縁五神四獣鏡 - 直径22.0センチメートル、厚さ0.2-0.3センチメートル。[[国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|国分寺古墳]]（[[鳥取県]][[倉吉市]]）出土鏡と同笵史跡説明板。。 *** 短冊型鉄斧 - 長さ24.8センチメートル、幅頭部5.5センチメートル、幅中央部6.0センチメートル、幅刃部7.0-7.5センチメートル、厚さ1-4センチメートル。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 関連施設 == * [[広島県立みよし風土記の丘|みよし風土記の丘ミュージアム（広島県立歴史民俗資料館）]]（三次市小田幸町） - 潮崎山古墳の伝出土鏡複製品等を展示。 * [[広島県立歴史博物館|ふくやま草戸千軒ミュージアム（広島県立歴史博物館）]]（福山市西町） - 潮崎山古墳の伝出土鏡複製品等を展示。 * 福山市しんいち歴史民俗博物館（福山市新市町） - 潮崎山古墳の伝出土鏡複製品等を展示。 == 参考文献 == * 史跡説明板（福山市教育委員会設置） * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=小都隆|year=1989|chapter=潮崎山古墳|title=[[日本古墳大辞典]]|publisher=[[東京堂出版]]|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|潮崎山古墳（古墳）|1989}}}} == 外部リンク == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html 伝潮崎山古墳出土三角縁五神四獣鏡及び短冊型鉄斧] - 広島県教育委員会「ホットライン教育ひろしま」 * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html 伝潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁五神四獣鏡] - 福山市ホームページ * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 潮崎山古墳] - 新市町観光協会 {{デフォルトソート:しおさきやまこふん}} [[category:広島県の古墳]] [[category:福山市の歴史]] [[category:前方後円墳]]

revision.text: == Significant Kofun with Triangular-Rimmed Mirrors == {{Miscellaneous content bullet list|section=1|date=April 2021}} The distribution of triangular-rimmed mirrors with deities and beasts by prefecture {{citation needed|date=2018-10}}{{questionable source range|1=shows that the highest number is found in Nara Prefecture with 100 mirrors, followed by Kyoto Prefecture with 66, Hyōgo Prefecture with over 40, and Osaka Prefecture with 38. The mirrors are predominantly excavated in the Kinki region, centered on the former [[Yamato Province]], but they are distributed nationwide from Kyushu to Tohoku. <!-- (Due to the lack of valid sources for the number of excavations in Fukuoka Prefecture, this part has been omitted temporarily.) For example, over 40 mirrors have been found in Fukuoka Prefecture and over 28 in the Kibi region. This suggests that the Kinki region (Kyoto, Nara, Osaka) centered on Nara accounts for a significant number of finds. Furthermore, the number of excavations in the Kinki region exceeds 270, making up more than half of the total. --><!--|title=Sources on total number of mirrors and their distribution are unclear. See notes for details.|talksection=About the number of mirrors and their distribution|date=October 2018}} --> [[Category:Japanese burial mounds]] [[Category:Historical mirrors in Japan]] [[Category:Archaeological sites in Japan]] [[ja:三角縁神獣鏡が確認された主な古墳]] {| class="wikitable" style="font-size:smaller; width:100%;" |+ Detailed Distribution |- ! For example, over 40 mirrors have been found in Fukuoka Prefecture and over 28 in the Kibi region. Furthermore, the number of excavations in the Kinki region exceeds 270, making up more than half of the total. --><!--|title=Sources on total number of mirrors and their distribution are unclear. header Significant Kofun with Triangular-Rimmed Mirrors header
{{Miscellaneous content bullet list|section=1|date=April 2021]] The distribution of triangular-rimmed mirrors with deities and beasts by prefecture {{citation needed|date=2018-10]]{{questionable source range|1=shows that the highest number is found in Nara Prefecture with 100 mirrors, followed by Kyoto Prefecture with 66, Hyōgo Prefecture with over 40, and Osaka Prefecture with 38. The mirrors are predominantly excavated in the Kinki region, centered on the former [[Yamato Province]], but they are distributed nationwide from Kyushu to Tohoku. <!-- (Due to the lack of valid sources for the number of excavations in Fukuoka Prefecture, this part has been omitted temporarily.) For example, over 40 mirrors have been found in Fukuoka Prefecture and over 28 in the Kibi region. This suggests that the Kinki region (Kyoto, Nara, Osaka) centered on Nara accounts for a significant number of finds. Furthermore, the number of excavations in the Kinki region exceeds 270, making up more than half of the total. --><!--|title=Sources on total number of mirrors and their distribution are unclear. {{Miscellaneous content bullet list|section=1|date=April 2021]] The distribution of triangular-rimmed mirrors with deities and beasts by prefecture {{citation needed|date=2018-10]]{{questionable source range|1=shows that the highest number is found in Nara Prefecture with 100 mirrors, followed by Kyoto Prefecture with 66, Hyōgo Prefecture with over 40, and Osaka Prefecture with 38. The mirrors are predominantly excavated in the Kinki region, centered on the former [[Yamato Province]], but they are distributed nationwide from Kyushu to Tohoku. <!-- (Due to the lack of valid sources for the number of excavations in Fukuoka Prefecture, this part has been omitted temporarily.) For example, over 40 mirrors have been found in Fukuoka Prefecture and over 28 in the Kibi region. This suggests that the Kinki region (Kyoto, Nara, Osaka) centered on Nara accounts for a significant number of finds. Furthermore, the number of excavations in the Kinki region exceeds 270, making up more than half of the total. --><!--|title=Sources on total number of mirrors and their distribution are unclear. {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} [[Category:Kofun in Hiroshima Prefecture]] {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} [[Category:Kofun in Hiroshima Prefecture]] {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at revision.text:
{{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|SeCategoryaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, seCategoryaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|SeCategoryaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, seCategoryaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 **Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)**] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}} Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property** (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient **kofun** (burial mound) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its shape is **not fully confirmed**, it is **presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)**. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a **Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)** and an **iron axe**, are **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties**. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}**}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated **on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)** in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was **excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)** and is recorded in **"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)**. However, **no modern archaeological investigations** have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been **heavily altered and eroded**, but based on estimates, it was originally **a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters**, with a **rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the **historical records from Seibi Meiku**, the tomb likely contained **a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, **a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)** and **an iron axe** were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been **built in the 4th century** during the **early Kofun period**, making it one of the **earliest keyhole-shaped kofun** in the **Bingo region**.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** in 1981 and 1982. Today, a **grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)** stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Cultural Properties == ### **Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Properties** * **Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)** * **"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)** – Designated in **1981 (Showa 56)**, expanded in **1982 (Showa 57)** to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). * **Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror** - **Diameter**: 22.0 cm - **Thickness**: 0.2 - 0.3 cm - **Identical in design to a mirror excavated from** {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in **Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture**. * **Iron Axe** (短冊型鉄斧) - **Length**: 24.8 cm - **Width at head**: 5.5 cm - **Width at center**: 6.0 cm - **Width at blade**: 7.0 - 7.5 cm - **Thickness**: 1 - 4 cm == References == {{Reflist}} == Related Facilities == The **replica** of the **mirror** and **other related artifacts** from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * **{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)** – **Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror**. * **{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)** – **Replica of the excavated mirror**. * **Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)** – **Display of artifact replicas**. == Bibliography == * **Site information sign** (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education). * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}} * (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html **Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"**] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html **Fukuyama City Website: "Excavated Artifacts from
