Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related artifacts''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site information sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related artifacts''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site information sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

{{afc comment|1=trimming these off. the parameter works as "burial" so no need to use "Burial Facility"[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 03:35, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=added parameters Interred_individual and Mausoleum is planned to be added but I messed up in template editing[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 02:40, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=now we have a 'burial' and 'burial goods' parameter. So a lot of these pages might not be marked on our wiki as having unknown parameters. But specifically keeping this comment here in case of import, these parameters should be added to [[Template:infobox ancient site]] rather than deleted from this draft or article[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 02:02, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=I hope this is not too annoying but this article is gonna be placed under [[:Category:Pages using infobox ancient site with unknown parameters]] and there is a decent chance these unknown parameters are ones[[Category:marked infobox kofun with unknown parameters]] I want added to the main template like burial chamber structure and burial goods. Please do not use any bots that just remove the unknown parameters without looking at them. This was added through [[Special:MassEditRegex]] to all pages with the category so apologies if it was just some kind of an error like the image parameter being in Japanese[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 06:00, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related artifacts''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site information sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

* {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html '''Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"'''] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html '''Fukuyama City Website: "burial goods from Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | artifacts = Presumed artifacts: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designated = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been designated as a historical site, but artifacts traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designated as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional artifacts.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related artifacts''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site information sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | latitude = 34.5407 | longitude = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site information sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site information sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

But specifically keeping this comment here in case of import, these parameters should be added to [[Template:infobox ancient site]] rather than deleted from this draft or article[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 02:02, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=I hope this is not too annoying but this article is gonna be placed under [[:Category:Pages using infobox ancient site with unknown parameters]] and there is a decent chance these unknown parameters are ones[[Category:marked infobox kofun with unknown parameters]] I want added to the main template like burial chamber structure and burial goods. Please do not use any bots that just remove the unknown parameters without looking at them. This was added through [[Special:MassEditRegex]] to all pages with the category so apologies if it was just some kind of an error like the image parameter being in Japanese[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 06:00, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).
* {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}}
* {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html '''Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"'''] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html '''Fukuyama City Website: "burial goods from However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

{{afc comment|1=trimming these off. the parameter works as "burial" so no need to use "burial Facility"[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 03:35, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=added parameters Interred_individual and Mausoleum is planned to be added but I messed up in template editing[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 02:40, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=now we have a 'burial' and 'burial goods' parameter. So a lot of these pages might not be marked on our wiki as having unknown parameters. But specifically keeping this comment here in case of import, these parameters should be added to [[Template:infobox ancient site]] rather than deleted from this draft or article[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 02:02, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=I hope this is not too annoying but this article is gonna be placed under [[:Category:Pages using infobox ancient site with unknown parameters]] and there is a decent chance these unknown parameters are ones[[Category:marked infobox kofun with unknown parameters]] I want added to the main template like burial chamber structure and burial goods. Please do not use any bots that just remove the unknown parameters without looking at them. This was added through [[Special:MassEditRegex]] to all pages with the category so apologies if it was just some kind of an error like the image parameter being in Japanese[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 06:00, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

But specifically keeping this comment here in case of import, these parameters should be added to [[Template:infobox ancient site]] rather than deleted from this draft or article[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 02:02, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=I hope this is not too annoying but this article is gonna be placed under [[:Category:Pages using infobox ancient site with unknown parameters]] and there is a decent chance these unknown parameters are ones[[Category:marked infobox kofun with unknown parameters]] I want added to the main template like burial chamber structure and burial goods. Please do not use any bots that just remove the unknown parameters without looking at them. This was added through [[Special:MassEditRegex]] to all pages with the category so apologies if it was just some kind of an error like the image parameter being in Japanese[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 06:00, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{Infobox Kofun | name = Shiozakiyama Kofun | native_name = 潮崎山古墳 | image = [[File:Shiozakiyama Kofun, funkyu.jpg|280px]]
Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed {{ill|Zenpokoenfun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun}} (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | other_designation1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important Cultural Property''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|ja|福山市}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been other_designation1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were other_designation1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == other_designation == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important Cultural Property (Tangible Cultural Property)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''{{ill|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum|ja|広島県立歴史博物館}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).
* {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=Koto Takashi (小都隆)|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典}}|publisher={{ill|Tokyodo Publishing|ja|東京堂出版}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}}}
* {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I (新市町史 資料編I)|publisher=Shin'ichi Town, Ashida District, Hiroshima (広島県芦品郡新市町)|ref={{Harvid|Shin'ichi Town History, Volume I|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html '''Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education: "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"'''] * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html '''Fukuyama City Website: "burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun"'''] * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 '''Shiozakiyama Kofun (Shin'ichi Tourism Association)'''] {{DEFAULTSORT:Shiozakiyama Kofun}}
