Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sekkaku (burial chamber)|qq=}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjukyo|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | Historic Site1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important designation1''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Historic Site == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important designation1 (Tangible designation1)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''[[:en:Hiroshima Prefectural Museum of History|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum]] (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sekkaku (burial chamber)|qq=}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjukyo|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | Historic Site1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important designation1''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Historic Site == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important designation1 (Tangible designation1)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''[[:en:Hiroshima Prefectural Museum of History|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum]] (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in [[:en:Tottori Prefecture|Tottori Prefecture]]{{Sfn|Description Board}}. *** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm. == References == {{reflist}} == Related Facilities == * {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}} (Miyoshi City, Kodakochō) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun. * {{ill|Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|ja|福山市立しんいち歴史民俗博物館|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|qq=}} (Shinichi, Fukuyama City) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods. * Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum (Fukuyama City) - Displays related materials. == Bibliography == * Description board (installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|editor=|author=Koitsu Takashi|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典|1=Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nihon Kofun Daijiten|13=User:Immanuelle/Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=}}|publisher={{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|ja|東京堂出版|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkyōdō Shuppan|qq=}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shinichi Town History: Materials Volume I|publisher=Shinichi Town, Hiroshima Prefecture|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|Shinichi Town History|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] - Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in [[:en:Tottori Prefecture|Tottori Prefecture]]{{Sfn|Description Board}}. *** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm. == References == {{reflist}} == Related Facilities == * {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}} (Miyoshi City, Kodakochō) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun. * {{ill|Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|ja|福山市立しんいち歴史民俗博物館|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Shinichi, Fukuyama City) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods. * Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum (Fukuyama City) - Displays related materials. == Bibliography == * Description board (installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|editor=|author=Koitsu Takashi|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典|1=Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nihon Kofun Daijiten|13=User:Immanuelle/Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=}}|publisher={{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|ja|東京堂出版|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkyōdō Shuppan|qq=}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shinichi Town History: Materials Volume I|publisher=Shinichi Town, Hiroshima Prefecture|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|Shinichi Town History|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] - Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in [[:en:Tottori Prefecture|Tottori Prefecture]]{{Sfn|Description Board}}. *** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm. == References == {{reflist}} == Related Facilities == * {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}} (Miyoshi City, Kodakochō) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun. * {{ill|Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|ja|福山市立しんいち歴史民俗博物館|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Shinichi, Fukuyama City) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods. * Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum (Fukuyama City) - Displays related materials. == Bibliography == * Description board (installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|editor=|author=Koitsu Takashi|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典|1=Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nihon Kofun Daijiten|13=User:Immanuelle/Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=}}|publisher={{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|ja|東京堂出版|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkyōdō Shuppan|qq=}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shinichi Town History: Materials Volume I|publisher=Shinichi Town, Hiroshima Prefecture|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|Shinichi Town History|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] - Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education * [https://www.city.fukuyama.hiroshima.jp/soshiki/bunka/64212.html Mirror from Shiozakiyama Kofun] - Fukuyama City Website * [https://www.k-shinichi.com/spot?id=31 Shiozakiyama Kofun] - While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Historic Site == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important designation1 (Tangible designation1)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''[[:en:Hiroshima Prefectural Museum of History|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum]] (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in [[:en:Tottori Prefecture|Tottori Prefecture]]{{Sfn|Description Board}}. *** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm. == References == {{reflist}} == Related Facilities == * {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}} (Miyoshi City, Kodakochō) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun. * {{ill|Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|ja|福山市立しんいち歴史民俗博物館|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Shinichi, Fukuyama City) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods. * Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum (Fukuyama City) - Displays related materials. == Bibliography == * Description board (installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|editor=|author=Koitsu Takashi|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典|1=Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nihon Kofun Daijiten|13=User:Immanuelle/Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=}}|publisher={{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|ja|東京堂出版|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkyōdō Shuppan|qq=}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shinichi Town History: Materials Volume I|publisher=Shinichi Town, Hiroshima Prefecture|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|Shinichi Town History|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] - While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Historic Site == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important designation1 (Tangible designation1)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''[[:en:Hiroshima Prefectural Museum of History|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum]] (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Mound (foreground: presumed front section; back left: presumed rear section) | location = {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima, Japan | coordinates = 34.5407 | coordinates = 133.2847 | region = Japan | type = Presumed [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] (keyhole-shaped tumulus) | length = Approx. 30m (estimated) | burial = Presumed {{ill|Sekkaku (burial chamber)|ja|石槨|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sekkaku (burial chamber)|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (stone chamber) | built = 4th century | burial goods = Presumed burial goods: {{ill|Sankakuen shinjukyo|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjukyo|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} (triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror), iron axe | Historic Site1 = None (historical site), '''Hiroshima Prefectural Important designation1''' (excavated mirror & iron axe) }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Historic Site == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important designation1 (Tangible designation1)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - 7.5 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 1 - 4 cm == Related Facilities == The '''replica''' of the '''mirror''' and '''other related burial goods''' from Shiozakiyama Kofun are exhibited at several museums: * '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}} (Hiroshima Prefectural History and Folklore Museum, Miyoshi)''' – '''Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror'''. * '''[[:en:Hiroshima Prefectural Museum of History|Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum]] (Hiroshima Prefectural History Museum, Fukuyama)''' – '''Replica of the excavated mirror'''. * '''Shin'ichi History and Folklore Museum (しんいち歴史民俗博物館, Fukuyama)''' – '''Display of artifact replicas'''. == References == {{Reflist}} == Bibliography == * '''Site intypeation sign''' (Installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education).

Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in [[:en:Tottori Prefecture|Tottori Prefecture]]{{Sfn|Description Board}}. *** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm. == References == {{reflist}} == Related Facilities == * {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}} (Miyoshi City, Kodakochō) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun. * {{ill|Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|ja|福山市立しんいち歴史民俗博物館|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Shinichi, Fukuyama City) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods. * Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum (Fukuyama City) - Displays related materials. == Bibliography == * Description board (installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|editor=|author=Koitsu Takashi|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典|1=Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nihon Kofun Daijiten|13=User:Immanuelle/Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=}}|publisher={{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|ja|東京堂出版|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkyōdō Shuppan|qq=}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shinichi Town History: Materials Volume I|publisher=Shinichi Town, Hiroshima Prefecture|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|Shinichi Town History|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] - While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]'''. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|qq=}}'''}}]] Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound. == Historic Site == === '''Hiroshima Prefectural [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]''' === * '''Important designation1 (Tangible designation1)''' ** '''"Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo" (三角縁五神四獣鏡) and Iron Axe (短冊型鉄斧)''' – Designated in '''1981 (Showa 56)''', expanded in '''1982 (Showa 57)''' to include additional burial goods.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html "Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo & Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun"] (Hiroshima Prefectural Board of Education). ** '''Sankakuen Goshin Shijukyo mirror''' ''' '''Diameter''': 22.0 cm ''' '''Thickness''': 0.2 - 0.3 cm ''' '''Identical in design to a mirror excavated from''' {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in '''Kurayoshi, Tottori Prefecture'''. ** '''Iron Axe''' (短冊型鉄斧) ''' '''Length''': 24.8 cm ''' '''Width at head''': 5.5 cm ''' '''Width at center''': 6.0 cm ''' '''Width at blade''': 7.0 - Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in [[:en:Tottori Prefecture|Tottori Prefecture]]{{Sfn|Description Board}}. *** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm. == References == {{reflist}} == Related Facilities == * {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}} (Miyoshi City, Kodakochō) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun. * {{ill|Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|ja|福山市立しんいち歴史民俗博物館|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Shinichi, Fukuyama City) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods. * Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum (Fukuyama City) - Displays related materials. == Bibliography == * Description board (installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|editor=|author=Koitsu Takashi|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典|1=Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nihon Kofun Daijiten|13=User:Immanuelle/Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=}}|publisher={{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|ja|東京堂出版|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkyōdō Shuppan|qq=}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shinichi Town History: Materials Volume I|publisher=Shinichi Town, Hiroshima Prefecture|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|Shinichi Town History|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] - Kofun (foreground shows assumed front section, rear-left shows assumed circular section). | alternate_name = | part_of = | location = [[:en:Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima Prefecture]][[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]]{{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}} Ōaza Sagata | coordinates = 34.540711 | coordinates = 133.284658 | type = (Assumed) [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] | area = | burial = (Trad.) stone chamber | burial goods = (Trad.) {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}, iron axe | Kofun = | built = 4th century | Individual = | Mausoleum = | Historic Site = None | Historic Site = Mirror and iron axe (Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site) | notes = | map = Japan Hiroshima | type = | map_dot_label = Shiozakiyama Kofun | map_dot_label = top }} '''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]] located in {{ill|Shinichi, Hiroshima|ja|新市町|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|qq=}}, [[:en:Fukuyama, Hiroshima|Fukuyama, Hiroshima]], Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the [[:en:Kofun period|Kofun period]] (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]]. == Overview == [[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}}.}}]] The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the [[:en:Ashida River|Ashida River]] and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ([[:en:Bunsei|Bunsei]] 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Saibimeiku|ja|西備名区|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|qq=}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted. The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Sankakuen shinjūkyō|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|1=Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|qq=}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the [[:en:Bingo Province|Bingo Province]] region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture [[:en:Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Important Cultural Property]] in 1981 and 1982, respectively. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin. == Historic Site == === Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site === * Important designation1 (Tangible designation1) ** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima"). *** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|qq=}} in [[:en:Tottori Prefecture|Tottori Prefecture]]{{Sfn|Description Board}}. *** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm. == References == {{reflist}} == Related Facilities == * {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|qq=}} (Miyoshi City, Kodakochō) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods from Shiozakiyama Kofun. * {{ill|Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|ja|福山市立しんいち歴史民俗博物館|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fukuyama Museum of History and Folklore|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Shinichi, Fukuyama City) - Displays replicas of the mirror and other burial goods. * Fukuyama Kusado Sengen Museum (Fukuyama City) - Displays related materials. == Bibliography == * Description board (installed by the Fukuyama City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|editor=|author=Koitsu Takashi|year=1989|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title={{ill|Nihon Kofun Daijiten|ja|日本古墳大辞典|1=Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nihon Kofun Daijiten|13=User:Immanuelle/Comprehensive Dictionary of Japanese Kofun|qq=}}|publisher={{ill|Tōkyōdō Shuppan|ja|東京堂出版|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōkyōdō Shuppan|qq=}}|isbn=4490102607|ref={{Harvid|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}}} * {{Cite book|editor=|author=|year=2002|chapter=Shiozakiyama Kofun|title=Shinichi Town History: Materials Volume I|publisher=Shinichi Town, Hiroshima Prefecture|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|Shinichi Town History|2002}}}} == External Links == * [https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] -
